title: Final height difference
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct numerical value for the height difference h, which is 40 cm (or 0.4 m).

title: Apply Boyle's Law
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply Boyle's law (pV = constant) to both the left and right gas chambers separately under isothermal conditions.

title: Relate initial volumes
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly use the given initial condition that the left chamber volume is half the right chamber volume (V01 = V02/2).

title: Use final volume condition
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly use the condition that the final volumes are equal and relate the sum of initial volumes to the final equal volumes.

title: Pressure difference from fluid
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly relate the final pressure difference between the chambers to the liquid height difference using p2 - p1 = ρgh.

title: Algebraic solution setup
description: Optional Criteria: The solution should clearly set up and solve the system of equations derived from the physical laws and conditions.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The solution should demonstrate consistent use of SI units (Pa, m³, kg/m³, m/s²) leading to an answer in meters or centimeters.

title: Sign error in pressure
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the pressure difference is incorrectly written as p1 - p2 = ρgh, reversing the relationship between the higher pressure side and the liquid column.

title: Incorrect volume relation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the relationship between initial volumes (V01 = V02/2) or the final equal volume condition is misapplied.
